info.title: whipstaff-yamltemplating
info.description: dot net tool to produce generate YAML files using templates.markdown from a System.CommandLine help summary.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates YAML files by merging template and content files.

options.name: --template
options.description: Path to the YAML template file

options.name: --content
options.description: Path to the YAML content file to merge

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output YAML file

options.name: --path
options.description: Dot-notation path within the content file where the template will be injected (e.g. steps.build.tasks). When omitted, the template and content files are merged at the root level.
